name: furl
description: Reversible context compression for Codex through six on-demand MCP tools and a retrieval-aware skill. Originals remain byte-exactly retrievable through <<ccr:HASH>> markers.

interface.shortDescription: Compress context without losing source data
interface.longDescription: Compress large logs, tool results, and files on demand through MCP while keeping every omitted byte retrievable by hash, filter, or line range.
defaultPrompt: Use Furl to compress large context and retrieve only the omitted details needed for this task.
